_comment: CANDIDATE for Hank to compare against data/palette.json. NOT FROZEN — a candidate written to data/palette.candidate.json. data/palette.json is the frozen palette and is untouched. 32 colours, weighted k-means over the source set. Ids c00-c31 are positional and stable; a swap is a VALUE SWAP, not a schema change. Regenerate/verify with `npx tsx tools/palette/fit.mjs` (deterministic, k-means++ seeded at 42). Method and per-image error live in _method / _validation below and in assets/approved-trials/_palette-candidate/_fit-report.json.

_method.algorithm: weighted k-means, k=32, k-means++ init seeded at 42 via core/rng.ts (no Math.random, G11)
_method.weightingRationale: Each source image contributes equal total weight (1/N) regardless of pixel count, because the town map holds ~353k distinct colours against ~49-60k for the sprites and naive pixel-pooling lets it buy the palette and starve the sprite classes of hue.
_method.backgroundExcluded: The plain white backdrop (§9.2 prompt skeleton) is flood-filled from the border and excluded from the cluster input, along with a 2px dilation that drops the anti-aliased rim. It is not a content colour and a slot spent on it is stolen from the artwork.
_method.quantizerMetric: Scoring assigns each source colour the way tools/postprocess/steps.ts::quantize does — nearest palette entry by squared euclidean distance in sRGB — so the reported error is the error the pipeline will actually produce, not the error of an idealised quantizer.
_method.selectionRule: Six candidates (2 fit spaces x 3 weightings). Rule stated before the numbers were seen: minimise the MAXIMUM per-image mean ΔE2000 — "serves every asset class" is a claim about the worst class, not the mean. Ties within 0.05 break on the overall mean. OVERRIDDEN: the rule selected lab/equal; srgb/equal was frozen instead. Reason: Matches the B0 freeze method exactly; only the SOURCE SET is broadened. Changing the weighting at the same time as the input would make the comparison uninterpretable.
excluded: assets/approved-trials/player-style-reference.png (style reference carrying an L6-forbidden cape; not an approved asset)

source: CANDIDATE — k-means over 19 trials (player, fox, croc, trainer, map, brackwater, r2-marsh, duskhollow, cindershelf, fenmaw, puddlisk, bogling, mirefin, undermere, duskstalk, wispurr, gloomoth, sporantle, webvern), sRGB / equal weighting, seed 42 — proposal, nothing is swapped
